old_problem: A generic RETIMER string or title query cannot distinguish multiple physical retimers or their upstream/downstream link segments. Exact bus/device identity, sensor coverage and Web mapping were project-specific. Historical review also treated the 1/2/19 numbering gap as potentially hidden checks, and needed an explicit boundary from active margin/retrain operations.
disposition_reason: Resolve Pending and Source Conflict. The test is a passive per-instance management-sensor comparison whose exact retimer inventory, link paths, OEM records and expected values are Project Configuration under ED-03/36. Full IB/OOB lists and Web visual evidence implement the explicit source coverage. Passive negotiated link/error state is context only; ED-19/30 prohibit importing active margining, reset or retrain. Criteria 1/2/19 remain verbatim, and absent numbered content is not invented.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2017, same-row tests.json/DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record, ED-01 through ED-30 and ipmitool/OpenBMC documentation were read; the actual next queue row was directly opened as Functionality 2018 / Wistron-BMC-01038-V002 / 89db257e5021da4c.
Standard IPMI read paths can enumerate records, while physical retimer identity and its upstream/downstream lane path are board/OEM mappings that must be versioned by the project.
Every retimer part/serial/firmware/bus location and lane group must map to a stable individual record or an aggregate whose instance coverage is explicit.
Passive width/speed/error and thermal context can reveal degraded paths but cannot replace SDR/Sensor/Web parity and does not authorize link manipulation.
The source states three comparison obligations; number 19 is retained as a formatting defect and is not authority for criteria 3–18.
No ipmitool, authentication, retimer/bus/link read, Web login/capture, amdxio, margin, reset/retrain, log clear, BMC, host or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: Per-retimer upstream/downstream-path management sensor parity across IB/OOB IPMI and Web
test_case.purpose: For every installed retimer, prove its exact individual or approved aggregate management sensors map to the correct upstream/downstream physical path and meet the versioned SPEC consistently across IB/OOB SDR, Sensor List and complete BMC Web evidence.
required_package: Exact SUT/BMC/BIOS and retimer part/serial/firmware/bus/address/location inventory
Versioned root-port-to-retimer-to-downstream-endpoint topology including upstream/downstream ports, lane groups, expected width/speed and populated applicability
Per-instance/aggregate retimer sensor SPEC and physical-to-IB-SDR/IB-list/OOB-SDR/OOB-list/Web crosswalk with units/states/thresholds/freshness
Approved ipmitool and passive read-only link queries, trusted protected OOB/Web access, aligned/cache/rounding/pagination rules
Passive link/error/thermal stop policy, complete evidence hashes, preserved logs and human Web/verdict ownership
test_case.test_command: READ-ONLY PACKAGE-GATED; freeze the approved retimer/link-path topology and bind each part/serial/firmware/bus address. Preserve logs. At aligned times capture complete untruncated IB and OOB `sdr elist`/`sensor list`, then apply the approved per-retimer crosswalk; retain raw data before filtering. Capture every BMC Web Sensor page with retimer/path identity and timestamps. Compare population and each name/description/type/unit/reading/state/threshold/freshness with SPEC and across views. Correlate passive width/speed/error/thermal context only. Never assume the testcase title is an SDR ID, use grep/head alone, execute amdxio/margining, reset/retrain/reconfigure links, clear logs or automatically retry.
test_case.expected_result: Every applicable retimer/path is represented exactly by approved individual or aggregate sensors; all IB/OOB/Web fields and aligned readings/states meet version-bound SPEC, passive links remain at expected width/speed without new disallowed errors/thermal alarms, and complete visual evidence agrees.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact per-retimer topology/identity, complete raw IB/OOB plus visual Web evidence, complete unique instance/aggregate coverage and all fields within SPEC/freshness rules, with healthy passive link context. FAIL on missing/extra/duplicate/misattributed path, wrong aggregate scope/unit/state/threshold, stale/out-of-range value, cross-view mismatch, degraded link/new error or incomplete evidence. Missing topology/SPEC is NOT READY; end user owns verdict.
safety_gate: Passive read-only only; prohibit amdxio/margining, reset, retrain, firmware/configuration/sensor/threshold writes and log clearing.
Bind every record to exact retimer and upstream/downstream path after complete raw capture; protect credentials.
Stop on mapping ambiguity, missing/duplicate record, degraded width/speed, new PCIe/fabric error, stale data or thermal alarm.
No automatic retry; preserve first discrepancy, full Web evidence and logs.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant, platform identity and per-retimer part/serial/firmware/bus/location inventory
Versioned upstream/downstream/lane topology plus individual/aggregate five-view sensor SPEC/crosswalk
Complete timestamped IB/OOB SDR elist and Sensor list raw outputs, exits and hashes
Complete BMC Web screenshots/export with path binding and pagination
Passive width/speed/error/thermal context, numbering-defect/no-margin/no-reset/no-clear/no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On wrong path/target, access, mapping, sensor/Web mismatch, degraded link, error or thermal anomaly, stop passive collection and preserve the first state. Close/revoke sessions and rotate exposed credentials. Do not margin, reset/retrain, clear logs or retry insecurely; escalate exact retimer/path and record IDs to PCIe/BMC owners.
